answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, graph-based local trust metrics operating on a social vertex network can effectively mitigate Sybil attacks. By evaluating the density of edge connections near a trusted harbor node, the protocol bounds the influence of poorly connected clusters. An attacker must expend substantial computational and relational capital to forge verified credentials, as each artificial profile—symbolized metaphorically by a raw jade block requiring extensive refinement—demands costly, non-outsourceable cryptographic proofs and peer endorsements to gain operational weight.
